model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the distribution of polarity scores. The x-axis is labeled "Polarity scores" and spans from -1.0 to 0.6 in linear increments of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "Counts" and ranges from 0 to 50000, with tick labels at 0, 10000, 20000, 30000, 40000 and 50000. A single blue, solid line with circular markers is present, starting at approximately 10000 counts at a polarity score of -1.0. The line increases to a peak of approximately 35000 counts at a polarity score of -0.2, then decreases to around 15000 counts at a polarity score of 0.0. It subsequently increases to roughly 25000 counts at a polarity score of 0.2, before declining again to approximately 10000 counts at a polarity score of 0.6.
